provenance: SYNTHETIC. Hand-written (reference, simulated-hypothesis) pairs, not real ASR output. fixtures/meetings/ has no real speech to transcribe -- the .wav files are a 2-second placeholder tone, see DATASET.md's 'Known limitations'. Each hypothesis simulates one documented ASR error pattern (see each pair's error_type) so run_evaluation.py can demonstrate that the WER implementation computes correctly. These numbers are NOT a measurement of WhisperSTT's real-world accuracy and must never be reported as one -- see docs/ml-evaluation.md.
